title: Stochastic inflows and seasonal water value at Manantali
summary: Seasonal hydropower operation requires release decisions that account for uncertain future inflows and the opportunity cost of stored water. We assess the Modelling and Optimisation of Stochastic Seasonal Hydropower Storage (MOSSHOOS) framework for the Manantali reservoir using 660 monthly energy-inflow observations from 1961--2015.
